articles.summary: Available now, the 3D SiP solution combines qualified assembly technologies and a sub-module toolbox to support miniaturized, highly integrated, and thin VRMs for vertical board-to-chip power delivery. By bringing voltage regulation closer to the processor, the vertical architecture can cut parasitic routing losses by 50% or more, helping improve overall system efficiency as AI compute power requirements continue to rise.
articles.title: ASE Expands PowerSiP™ Platform for Next-Generation AI Power Delivery
